Section I. . _ - ‘

PERMIT REQUIRED. It shali be unlawful to construct or alter any building or structure in the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia, excepting fences, when the cost of such construction exceeds One Thousand Dollars ($1,000.00) or where the effect of such construction or alterations to enlarge the capacity or affect the bearing walls of any building or the roof thereof, without having first secured a permit from the Town governing authority therefor.

Section II. .

APPLICATION. Application for such permits shall be made to the County/Town Inspector and shall be accompanied by plans and specifications in duplicate, clearly. showing the work to be done; such plans shall be verified by the signature of either the owner of the premises or by the architect or contractor in charge of the operations.

Section III. .

Such applications with plans shall be examined by the County/Town Inspector to determine whether the proposed construction or alteration will comply with all provisions relative thereto, Upon his approval, one set of plans shall be returned to the applicant with a permit, and the other shall be retained by the County/Town Inspector. No permit shall be @ssued until after approval of the plans and necessary fees are paid.

Section IV.

VARIATIONS. It shall be unlawful to vary materially from the submitted plans and specifications unless such variations are submitted in an amended plan to the County/Town Inspector and approved by him.

Section V. FEES. The fees for building permits shall be as follows:

- (a) A minimum fee of $10.00 will be charged.

{b) The County/Town Inspector shall determine, from the plans submitted to him, the square foot area of the proposed building or alteration. The County Tax Assessor shall “provide to the County/Town Inspector the square foot value of the proposed building or alteration, and based upon the value thus established, a charge of $1.00 per $1,000.00 ‘value will be charged for the permit.

RESOLVED that the above shall be effective to all building or alterations of buildings done in the incorporated area of Pine Mountain, Georgia, this the 12th day of June, 1989.
